title: Munhu Asingazununguki Anodana Chokwadi
intro: Mutumwa anomira ari ega pakati pevanhu vakasindimara, achivadana kuna Mwari Mumwe Chete Wechokwadi ivo vachiramba vakanamatira kuzvifananidzo zvenhema. Muprofita uyu ane zita rine revo ine simba—'uyo anotsvaga dziviriro'—asi anongorambwa nekuramba. Kuburikidza nekunyengetedzwa zvinyoro-nyoro uye yambiro yakasimba, mweya uyu unotakura shoko raMwari iro nyika pachayo ichareverera pakupedzisira. Unogona kuziva munhu uyu akasimba anomiririra imwe yenyaya dzekare mumagwaro echiIslam here?
clues: Vanhu vangu vainamata vamwari vakawanda, ini ndichivadana kuti vashumire Iye akasika denga nenyika.
Ndakamira pamberi pevanhu vangu ndikazivisa kuti hapana mubairo wandaizoda kubva kwavari—chishuwo changu chete kwaiva kutungamirirwa kwavo kukururama.
Mhepo huru yakatumirwa kuvanhu vangu sechirango chaMwari, mhepo iyo Korani inotaura nezvayo muzvimiro zvevazhinji uye zvevakadzi.
Kusiyana nevamwe vaprofita, handina kupiwa mudzimai kana vana vanotaurwa nezvavo zvakanyanya munhoroondo yangu, nekuti basa rangu raive rekudana vanhu vangu vega.
Zita rangu rine zvarinoreva zvakadzama—zvine chekuita nepfungwa yekudzivirirwa neutiziro hunotsvagwa nemunhu.
Vanhu vangu vaizivikanwa nezita renzvimbo yavo remupata wavaigara, uye nyika yavo yaitsanangurwa nekushorwa kukuru nekuda kwekushaya miti.
